headline: Multiple levers of profitable growth

highlights: Per (%) -15/-2/26 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1181 Free float (%) 72.0 Financials Snapshot (INR b) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E NII 30.7 35.0 44.3 PPP 25.8 30.6 39.6 PAT 22.9 25.1 29.1 EPS (INR) 88 96 112 EPS Gr.

Management targets overall portfolio growth of ~18-20% in FY27, with affordable housing and emerging markets expected to account for ~50% of the retail portfolio over the next two years, up from ~41% as of Sep’26.

While competitive pricing remains a near-term challenge, we expect NIMs of 3.6%/3.7% in FY27/FY28, respectively. ◼ Disciplined underwriting and stronger collections to sustain asset quality: PNBHF's asset quality remains healthy, with Stage 3 exhibiting improvement over the last many quarters.

We estimate credit costs to normalize to ~20bp in FY28, with portfolio seasoning and underwriting discipline remaining key monitorables. ◼ Strengthening growth franchise with earnings recovery; reiterate BUY: PNBHF's expanding affordable housing franchise, greater utilization of its existing branch network, and technology-led automation should support operating leverage.
